How does SCRIPE Data Exchange Studio Unify Portal UX, 17-Rule MENA Normalization, 5-Sheet DAG Imports, and CRUD Actions?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE Data Exchange Studio unifies full-viewport portal UX, 17-rule MENA normalization, 5-sheet topological CRM migrations, and GenericCrudView action menus across CRM, PartyKernel, and Identity.1

  1. DataExchangeStudioOverlay mounts via createPortal at z-[900] with body scroll lock and StudioConfirmExitDialog (z-[960]) guarding unsaved work.2
  2. ColumnNormalizationPopover (z-[950]) exposes all 17 O(n) DataExchangeTransformRule options in a context-smart scrollable body paired with Step 2 @core/ui/tooltip diagnostics.3
  3. DataExchangeOrchestrator executes 5-sheet CRM topological DAG imports (Account -> Contact -> Lead -> Opportunity -> Activity) while sileo-toast morphs dx-job-{id} states in place.4
  4. All 8 Admin, CRM, and Party views standardize on GenericCrudView getActions ⋯ dropdowns and flat matte Nexus CardGrid slabs.5

How does the Full-Viewport Portal Studio (z-[900]) coordinate validation, worker execution, and Sileo morphing?

Diagram structure
  • Tenant Operator operator
  • Portal Studio portal
  • Normalizer z-950 popover
  • DAG Orchestrator orchestrator
  • ImmediateWorker worker
  • Sileo & Dock sileo
  • operator → portal · Open Data Exchange Dropdown & Mount Portal (z-900)
  • portal → orchestrator · Upload .xlsx for Magic-Byte & ZIP-Ratio Inspect
  • orchestrator → portal · Return Sheets, Sample Rows & Compatibility Hash
  • operator → popover · Hover Incompatible Row Tooltip or Open Normalizer
  • popover → portal · Apply Smart Preset & Preview Raw -> Transformed
  • portal → orchestrator · Run 5-Sheet DAG Dry-Run & Edition Quota Check
  • portal → worker · Enqueue Job & Emit sileo-toast (id: dx-job-{id})
  • worker → orchestrator · Query IgnoreQueryFilters & Enter AmbientContext
  • orchestrator → sileo · Morph dx-job-{id} Pill (Queued -> Running -> Done)
  1. Portal Studio ↗

    Mounts on document.body at z-900 with w-screen h-screen overflow-hidden and body scroll lock.

  2. Normalizer z-950 ↗

    Layers tooltips, selects, and the 17-rule normalizer at z-950 above the z-900 studio shell.

  3. DAG Orchestrator ↗

    Validates OWASP signatures, runs O(n) MENA transforms, and resolves 5-sheet CRM parent keys.

  4. ImmediateWorker ↗

    Claims queued jobs with IgnoreQueryFilters and enters DataExchangeAmbientContext per tenant.

  5. Sileo & Dock ↗

    Updates one toast pill in place via id dx-job-{id} using localized entity display names.

Decomposing the monolithic overlay into eight focused sub-components under presentation/components/studio/ keeps every file within 250 lines while isolating z-index layers cleanly.2

How do StudioConfirmExitDialog and the 17-Rule ColumnNormalizationPopover protect operator mappings?

Diagram structure
  • Step 1 Upload step1_up
  • Step 2 Mapping step2_map
  • Step 3 Dry-Run step3_dry
  • Unsaved Work? dirty_gate
  • Confirm Exit z-960 exit_alert
  • Reset or Unmount clean_exit
  • dirty_gate → clean_exit · no
  • dirty_gate → exit_alert · yes
  • exit_alert → clean_exit · discard
  • step1_up → step2_map · inspect
  • step2_map → dirty_gate · X or Step 1
  • step2_map → step3_dry · dry-run
  • step3_dry → step2_map · lossless back
  1. Step 2 Mapping ↗

    Holds active column mappings, custom cf: fields, and 17-rule transforms after file inspection.

  2. Step 3 Dry-Run ↗

    Pressing Back from Step 3 returns to Step 2 immediately without clearing mappings or prompting.

  3. Unsaved Work? ↗

    Triggers on X, Escape, Back from Step 2 to Step 1, Replace File, or un-dismissed credentials.

  4. Confirm Exit z-960 ↗

    Renders above z-900 and z-950 layers with Keep Editing and destructive Discard & Exit buttons.

Inside Step 2, ColumnNormalizationPopover (w-[440px], max-h-[min(600px,82vh)], z-[950]) pairs sticky header and live preview bars with an overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain body (never no-scrollbar). It dynamically promotes the rule group matching targetDataType or Arabic sample text to the top with a Recommended badge and 1-click Apply Smart Preset button.3

How does 5-Sheet CRM Topological DAG Migration link parent records and morph sileo-toast states?

Diagram structure
  • 1. crm.account sh_acc
  • 2. crm.contact sh_con
  • 3. crm.lead sh_lead
  • 4. crm.opportunity sh_opp
  • 5. crm.activity sh_act
  • sessionResolvedKeys sess_map
  • Cascade & Rejected .xlsx rej_xlsx
  • sess_map → sh_opp · natural key
  • sh_acc → sess_map · register key
  • sh_acc → sh_con · account fk
  • sh_con → sh_lead · contact fk
  • sh_lead → rej_xlsx · bad parent
  • sh_lead → sh_opp · lead fk
  • sh_opp → sh_act · deal fk
  1. 1. crm.account ↗

    Imports sponsor and club accounts first and records ExternalKey and Name into sessionResolvedKeys.

  2. 2. crm.contact ↗

    Links contacts to newly staged or persisted accounts and handles pass-2 self-FK manager references.

  3. 3. crm.lead ↗

    Matches leads by Email, Title, or ExternalKey during both multi-sheet dry-run and chunk commit.

  4. 4. crm.opportunity ↗

    Resolves parent Account, Contact, and Lead links across earlier workbook sheets without false errors.

  5. 5. crm.activity ↗

    Links tasks and calls to upstream CRM entities while deferring children of rejected parent rows.

In-Place Sileo Toast Morphing & Localized Entity Names

Every job notification passes { id: "dx-job-" + job.id, title, description, button } to @core/ui/sileo-toast and resolves localized display names (such as Leads or العملاء المحتملون) instead of raw 'crm.lead' keys. As a job moves from Queued to Running and Completed, Failed, or Cancelled, Sileo morphs the existing toast pill in place with zero toast stacking.6

Why is the Entity Catalog Read-Only and How Do Zero-Coupling Plugins, Outbox Events, and Dynamic Governance Work?

DataTransfer keeps zero project references to sibling domain modules (DataTransfer.*.csproj reference only Core.* and AstraFlow.*), discovering entities through IEntityDataExchangeProvider in Core.Application and publishing terminal job completion via DataExchangeJobCompletedEvent in datatransfer.outbox_messages (retracted via DetachPendingOutboxMessages() on cancellation). On the frontend, GenericCrudView reads entityTypeKey and mounts @core/data-exchange (DataExchangeToolbarActions + useDataExchangeToolbarViewModel) automatically without ever importing @modules/admin/data-transfer.1

2-Pass Key Resolution & Deterministic 9-Stage Normalization Pipeline

Multi-sheet DAG imports run Kahn's TopologicalSortSheets (ParentEntityKeys / DependsOnEntityKeys), pass sessionResolvedKeys across sheets, persist idempotent lookups in datatransfer.external_legacy_key_maps, resolve self-FK links in Pass 2, and defer child rows with PARENT_ROW_FAILED (_CascadeParentRef). Every mapped cell runs deterministically through Stages 1–9 (NFKC/BiDi -> Arabic/Persian digits -> Null tokens -> Trim/Whitespace -> Tashkeel/Tatweel & Alef/ى/ک -> CaseMode -> Currency/Accounting -> Email/E.164/MultiValue -> Typed Parse & UTC).3
